create.name: Kamala Masters
create.bio:
Kamala Masters has practised Buddhist meditation since the mid-1970s, mainly in the Burmese Theravada lineages that grew from Mahasi Sayadaw. Her early teachers were Anagarika Munindra and Sayadaw U Pandita, under whom she trained intensively in insight and loving-kindness practice, both as a laywoman and as a nun, in the United States, Australia and Burma; she now continues her practice with Sayadaw U Tejaniya. With her partner Steve Armstrong, a former monk and long-serving teacher in the same lineage, she founded the Vipassana Metta Foundation on Maui, where the two are the principal teachers.

She leads silent retreats at centres around the world and serves as one of the guiding teachers of the Insight Meditation Society in Barre, Massachusetts. Her teaching joins careful attention with warmth, aiming to make the Buddha's path feel practical and humane in ordinary life. Through the foundation she guides Vipassana Metta at Home, a weekly online sitting and talk with occasional half-day retreats, offered freely on a donation basis, and the foundation's website keeps a library of her recorded talks and guided meditations. She raised four children on Maui and has seven grandchildren.

free_resources.title: Vipassana Metta at Home
free_resources.description: A weekly one-hour online gathering on Zoom with a guided sitting and a short talk or questions, plus half-day weekend retreats every month or so. It is offered on a donation basis, and recordings are kept for those who cannot join live.

free_resources.title: Guided Metta Meditation
free_resources.description: An audio recording of Kamala leading a loving-kindness sitting, from the foundation's talk library. Free to stream or download.

free_resources.title: Understanding Equanimity – Guided Meditation
free_resources.description: A guided sitting on steadiness and balance of mind, recorded on retreat. One of several of her recordings freely available on the foundation's website.

free_resources.title: Guided Metta for Turbulent Times
free_resources.description: A video of Kamala guiding loving-kindness practice on Maui. A gentle way in for anyone new to metta.
